modules.live_check: Re-run 2026-11-26: not called live by design - HoneyLabs and jamesbrine.com.au are terms 'unknown' (P147 c3); the live test asserts the corporate policy decision (SKIPPED) for a CVE and an IPv4 value; offline fixtures are the prep's live answers of 2026-11-26.

core_requests: noise (P147 c2): noise.errors() reports every runtime list registered with noise.register_list as 'dataset ... not downloaded' in a fresh home, and tests/test_registry_contract.py::test_noise_and_attack_have_no_errors requires noise.errors() == [], so no module can register a runtime noise list at import time as MODULE_GUIDE s.18 documents. Leave 'not downloaded' runtime lists out of noise.errors() (or add noise.pending()), or let the engine consult module noise-provider hooks; honeypot_intel exposes noise_kind_for(value) (local copy only) for the OffSeq known-scanners list meanwhile, like cloud_ranges.noise_kind_for.

dns (P045 c3): a per-call non-public resolver for keyed DNSBL zones, e.g. ctx.dns.dnsbl(label, zone, resolver='system') using dnspython, so Spamhaus DQS and http:BL can use the system resolver without switching every module to the global setting dns_mode=system.

votes (P046 c5): move the shared vote helper (vote_tally, vote_should_stop, dedupe_families, format_vote_line, format_value_votes in v3lum/modules/ip_network/ip_anonymizer_consensus.py) into core (e.g. v3lum/core/votes.py) for ip_geolocation (P051, batch p3-G02-2).

offline facts (P046 c4): a core lookup of offline IP facts (the P034 shared range index promoted to core, with the P035 VPN/hosting lists and P047 data) so online consensus modules can check 'offline lists answer first' without importing other batches' modules; ip_anonymizer_consensus reads the core noise lists, cloud_ranges.local_classification and the P040 Tor bulk list local copy today.

datasets: `v3lum data update` (WP18) should skip datasets whose registry source terms are 'unknown' or licence-blocked under the active profile unless named explicitly (honeypot_intel_extra.jamesbrine_* are registered while the source is disabled).
datasets: dataset groups verified against a publisher manifest (OffSeq Mirage SHA256SUMS + minisign .minisig; Ed25519 verification as an optional extra).

quota: DNS-only modules are never charged against Module.daily_quota (the engine counts res.requests, HTTP only); DNSBL fair-use caps cannot be enforced (count ctx.dns lookups of DNS-only modules, or allow provider quota blocks for DNS zones).
notes: P045 dnsbl: one provider fragment per DNSBL operator (hosts [] - DNS only; upstream_family 'dnsbl' for all, ONE spam family vote); Spamhaus DQS is its own provider 'spamhaus_dqs' (key + zen/dbl sources together, so the licence gate can read the key plan; the 'spamhaus' fragment owned by p1-G02-2 is untouched); primary provider spamcop; sources include core_doh.resolvers. SpamCop, DroneBL and UCEPROTECT go through ctx.dns (core DoH); Spamhaus DQS and http:BL only through ctx.dns.dnsbl with dns_mode=system and dnspython (else per-source UNAVAILABLE package / SKIPPED config); Barracuda/SURBL/URIBL only when setting dnsbl_registered_lists names them and a non-public resolver exists; otherwise ONE coverage line (attribute dnsbl_not_queried).
